ideas.idea: List the actual breads with headings and descriptions on /breads.html
ideas.why: The page names only two of twenty-plus loaves, so naming them gives readers and machines specific content to quote.

ideas.idea: Add class details (dates, price, size, duration, booking link) to /classes.html
ideas.why: The page has no concrete details, and adding them gives people and machines the facts they need.

ideas.idea: Image /img/loaves.jpg may be missing from the repo
ideas.why: No img folder exists in the files, so the image may 404 and the report hedges this correctly.

ideas.idea: Back up 'wide range' on the home page by naming grains or loaves
ideas.why: The claim is vague in index.html, and naming specifics gives readers something concrete.

ideas.idea: Explain how to pre-order, with cut-off and collection times
ideas.why: index.html says 'Pre-order for weekend collection' with no method, so the instructions are missing.

ideas.idea: Add address and opening hours as text, possibly with Bakery structured data
ideas.why: No page states the address or hours, and a local bakery benefits from having them in plain text.

ideas.idea: Link the home page to Classes in body text
ideas.why: The home body links only to Breads, though the nav does link to Classes, so this is a real but modest internal-linking improvement.

ideas.idea: Confirm crawlers get through the host or CDN
ideas.why: It is a check outside the code that applies to any site, and the task says to leave such items out.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data for site identity
ideas.why: It contradicts the stated choice that having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.
It is accurate since the sitemap has no lastmod, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add og:title, og:description and og:image social tags
ideas.why: The tags are missing, but this is standard advice for any site and mainly affects social previews.

ideas.idea: Make the home title more specific with street or area
ideas.why: The report itself calls the title fine, so the change would have very little effect.

ideas.idea: Create a page per loaf later
ideas.why: It is speculative and could apply to any site that sells products.
